notes: Verified against the UCSD General Catalog (catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/CIN.html), fetched twice with consistent results, and cross-checked against the IAH Film Studies page. Total 19 courses / 76 units (7 lower-division = 28 units + 12 upper-division = 48 units). All major courses must be taken for a letter grade with a grade of C- or better. Many options are cross-listed; both codes of each cross-listing are retained. Discrepancy resolved: the capstone is FILM 185 (the department-overview page's 'CINE 185' label is a paraphrase; the authoritative catalog states 'FILM 185. Cinematic Arts Capstone'). Every production and screenwriting code was individually confirmed against the catalog's General/Editing-and-Sound/Animation/Shooting-and-Staging groups. The Upper-Division Elective bucket uses representative course-number ranges (not specific codes) because it is an open elective drawn from the studies/history or production lists or independent study.

buckets.label: Cinematography (lower-division foundation)
buckets.note: FILM 71 and VIS 71 are equivalent cross-listings; take one. Part of the 4-course lower-division foundation.

buckets.label: Directing (lower-division foundation)
buckets.note: FILM 72 and VIS 72 are equivalent cross-listings; take one.

buckets.label: Editing (lower-division foundation)
buckets.note: FILM 73 and VIS 73 are equivalent cross-listings; take one.

buckets.label: Lower-Division Electives (choose 3)
buckets.note: Choose three from this list. All confirmed lower-division on the catalog page.

buckets.label: Studies and History Courses (choose 5)
buckets.note: Choose five. Several entries are cross-listings (e.g. CGS 119/LTCS 119, ETHN 163F/TDGE 131, LTAF 120/120GS, LTCS 172/172GS, LTWL 180/180GS). Subject-code families and division confirmed against the catalog; all are upper-division (100+).

buckets.label: Screenwriting Production Course (choose 1)
buckets.note: Of the 4 required production courses, one must be a screenwriting course. All five options confirmed on the catalog page. Counts as 1 of the 4 production courses.

buckets.label: Production Courses (choose 3 additional)
buckets.note: Choose 4 production courses total, one being screenwriting (separate bucket); these are the remaining 3 across the General, Editing/Sound, Animation, and Shooting/Staging groups. All codes verified. Cross-listings shown as separate codes: FILM 179/VIS 173, FILM 180/VIS 180, FILM 182/VIS 183.

buckets.label: Upper-Division Elective (1 course)
buckets.note: One additional 4+ unit upper-division course from the studies/history list, production list, or independent study. Open elective; entries are representative subject/number ranges, not specific catalog codes.

buckets.note: Required. FILM 185 Cinematic Arts Capstone. Catalog confirms FILM 185 (not CINE 185).
